svg.title: DIA-003 · The runout
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a rock face in section, its beds drawn in the manner of a geological survey. A lead climber, drawn as a silhouette in hat, jacket and boots, is high on the face, just above a level marked frontier. Ledges below are marked GPT-3, ChatGPT and GPT-4. The rope runs down from the climber's waist to four anchors clustered near the ground, the highest just above the level marked routine, and then out to a belayer who stands braced on the ground with the rope in both hands. A rust dimension line marks the long stretch of rope between the last anchor and the climber: the runout.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 3 · WHAT'S UNSOLVED AT THAT SPEED
DIA-003 · The gap does not predict a slip. It sets what a slip would cost, and it grows with every move made above the last anchor.
